thread:
Maya Chen: quick heads-up on Aerolyft onboarding telemetry — noticed p95 latency drift specifically for long-doc summarization (requests >512 tokens). errors are small but trending up. proposing a cautious optimization: swap a small percent to an int8 variant + a regional canary to test routing impact.
Devin Arora: curious about magnitudes.
Maya Chen: 72h window: avg latency ~230ms, p95 ~680ms on long requests, error rate crept to ~0.8% (timeouts dominate). cost/1k tokens up ~14% vs their previous baseline. idea: route 5% of long-doc traffic to rw-open-3b-q8 in us-west-2, keep main on rw-open-7b in us-east.
Samir Patel: what's the expected quality delta from q8? we should be explicit for the CS team.
Devin Arora: ran their summary prompts on our eval harness — q8 shows ~0.6% BLEU drop for ultra-long cases, ~0.1-0.2% for standard summaries. seems acceptable if latency/cost improves.
Maya Chen: draft rollout config below — canary 5% then ramp to 20/50 if metrics look good.
```yaml
routing_policy:
  name: aerolyft-long-docs-optimization
  match:
    - header: content-length-tokens
      op: ">"
      value: 512
  routes:
    - model: rw-open-3b-q8
      region: us-west-2
      weight: 0.05
      canary: true
    - model: rw-open-7b
      region: us-east-1
      weight: 0.95
rollout:
  monitor: telemetry/aerolyft/long-docs
  metrics:
    - latency.p95
    - errors.rate
  auto-roll-back: true
  ramp: [5, 20, 50]
```
Maya Chen: also recommending prefix KV caching for document-store IDs for repeated summarizations — should cut token counts on reruns. i'll prepare enablement materials and propose a 30-min customer/dev sync.
Devin Arora: i'll own nightly eval jobs for the canary cohort and sampling checks. we should fail fast if quality delta >1% at any ramp step.
Samir Patel: infra note: us-west dedicated pool has some spare capacity but it's shared. need ops to confirm headroom for additional q8 capacity if canary ramps. pinging @eng-runtime for capacity confirmation.
eng-runtime-bot: Deploy plan drafted: https://console.redwood/deploys/plan/4288881234 - canary window 2h, alert hooks attached.
Maya Chen: great. action items: 1) ops confirm pool headroom, 2) devs review routing yaml, 3) ML to run nightly evals and add sampling, 4) schedule customer enablement call. will tag Aerolyft when infra green. :thumbsup:
Devin Arora: noted. i'll abort if sampled quality >1% drop. that's configured in rollout.
Samir Patel: will update ops ticket once infra confirms.
ops-deploy: Canary created: deploy-4288881234-canary (5%). logs -> https://logs.redwood/aerolyft/4288881234
Maya Chen: scheduling tentative enablement Thu 10:30 PT; pulling together short slide + checklist for the call. thanks team.
